verdict.rationale: The only in-product AI-like capability is the "Describe your search" panel. There you describe what you want in plain language and Honeybadger writes the search query for you, so you can delegate one narrow task (query authoring). The MCP server serves external AI assistants and is a different story, so it earns no credit here. missing for 10: a general-purpose built-in AI assistant or agent, delegation of tasks beyond search (triage, root-cause analysis, fixes), explicit documentation that the search panel is AI-driven, independent or hands-on corroboration.
